quote: The current study partially replicated and extended previous findings from an earlier multimodal study (Honea 2009).
reason: The target description covers the relationship of APOE-ε alleles with both brain structure and cognitive function, and the authors explicitly conclude that their study partially replicated Honea et al. (2009). Specifically, they report replicating the null corrected brain-structure (GMV and WMI) findings while failing to replicate the cognitive performance differences.
